baseline.source: exact canonical V1/V2 EEGNet final-refit checkpoint

evaluation.metric_primary: biological-subject-equal future-session S2 balanced accuracy after five-fold probability mean
evaluation.probability_aggregation: softmax each fold logits, average probabilities equally across five folds

geometry.PCA: randomized TRAIN-only PCA on h_C; K=min(16,rank(C)); canonical signs; seed locked per task/fold
geometry.procedure: recomputed with audited V2 PERSIST final-refit fit_bases procedure on non-final-heldout refit pool

interpretation_state_rules.POSITIVE_ROUTING_ONLY: positive-only minus baseline BA CI lower > 0, while UGCR-V3 minus positive-only BA CI upper <= 0
interpretation_state_rules.SELECTIVE_ROUTING_ACTIONABLE: UGCR-V3 BA CI lower > 0 vs baseline, shuffled, random mean, and best random
interpretation_state_rules.TASK_DEPENDENT_SELECTIVE_ROUTING: other task-specific or mixed result patterns
interpretation_state_rules.UTILITY_NOT_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC: UGCR-V3 minus shuffled and random-mean BA CIs both include 0
interpretation_state_rules.UTILITY_STRUCTURE_NON_ACTIONABLE: UGCR-V3 minus baseline and positive-only minus baseline BA CI upper <= 0

model_construction: h_s_route=mu_s+Q_s Q_s^T(h_s-mu_s)+C_residual+sum_j r_j a_j c_j; preserve native full-forward successor C_d in h_d=mu_d+Q_d p_d_route+c_d_full
protocol_freeze: no routing, basis, coefficient, threshold, metric, or evaluation-code changes after this file is written

routing.positive_only: boost C+ with same S, other directions r=1
routing.scale: S=max |U_P| across significant C+ and C- directions; r=1 when none
routing.shuffle: same PCA basis and exact primary coefficient multiset; prelocked derangement

utility.aggregation: session means within biological subject, then subject-equal
utility.source: exact V2.5 eval_primary native-coordinate erasure P-mediated margin estimand
